project.title: Anaerobic digester system Metagenome of a full-scale Wastewater Treatment Plant in Dubai, UAE
project.description: The main aim of this study is to evaluate diversity of the microbial community in the anaerobic sludge digester systems of full-scale wastewater treatment systems in Dubai, UAE.
